metadata.description: Simulated international and continental tournaments with explicit national-team pools and stages.

tournaments.name: Africa Cup of Nations

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: Top four in each group qualify for the quarter-finals.

rules: Eight national teams qualify for the group stage.
Group matches award three points for a win and one for a draw.
The top four teams in each group advance to the quarter-finals.
Knockout matches use extra time and penalties if required.

tournaments.name: UEFA European Championship

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: Top two teams in each group advance to the quarter-finals.

rules: Fifteen national teams compete in four groups.
Three points are awarded for a win and one for a draw.
The top two teams in each group advance.
Knockout ties are decided by extra time and penalties when level.

tournaments.name: Copa América

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: The top two teams in each group qualify for the semi-finals.

rules: Four invited national teams are split into two groups.
Each team plays the other team in its group.
Both teams in each group advance to the semi-finals.
Knockout matches use extra time and penalties when required.

tournaments.name: AFC Asian Cup

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: Both teams qualify for the final.

rules: National teams are drawn into a round-robin group.
Three points are awarded for a win and one for a draw.
The top two teams qualify for the final.
The final is decided by extra time and penalties when required.

tournaments.name: CONCACAF Gold Cup

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: The top two teams qualify for the final.

rules: National teams from the North American region compete for the continental title.
Group matches award three points for a win and one for a draw.
The top two teams advance to the final.
The final is decided by extra time and penalties if level.

tournaments.name: FIFA World Cup

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.advancement: The top two teams and four best third-placed teams advance to the round of 16.

rules: Thirty national teams are drawn into six groups.
Each team plays every other team in its group once.
The top two teams and four best third-placed teams advance.
Knockout matches use extra time and penalties when required.
